title: Determinant-valuation min-max duality for full-rank lattices over a discrete valuation ring
author: Ian Le
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 4 (2021), no. 5, 823-841; DOI 10.5802/alco.182; native source SHA256 47ca82c3a281e4f5c1018d71f5a042450371e83184cbc50234356c34f00e8184
difficulty_reason: After Hall, Rado, Konig, and Kuhn-Munkres prerequisites, the proof constructs a deficiency witness in residual representative spaces, lifts it to a fractional lattice enlargement, and proves strict integral potential improvement until simultaneous tight generators exist. This non-coordinate lattice min-max termination argument is beyond routine qualification exercises.
